scientific_integrity: Exact finite Gaussian log-determinant moments and a growing-dimension central limit theorem are proved analytically; finite numerical checks are supplementary and do not imply an infinite proof. Log-volume is not a smallest-singular-value or conditioning theorem.
title: Exact Gaussian log-volume fluctuations for a critical cyclic Gabor basis
